rules: Fields both scorers agree on are adopted unchanged.
The first run's written rules apply: margins judged at normal viewing size; halo, title, rock and corner glyphs count as lettering, conservatively.
Watercolor soft edges are recorded but do not make an image flawed (ADR 0006 amendment 2); a painted frame still does.
Unrequested, prominent figures count as extra figures, as in the first run.
noFormFigure no/na disputes resolve to no; neither is a figure.

scores.notes: Operator (matchesScene disputed): noFormFigure no/na: no figure either way; matchesScene takes the lower label. A: Moses at left with his arm out and a crook staff, walls of water on both sides, and God shown only as a fiery cloud pillar at top center with no face or figure; painting reaches all four edges. The Israelites are already filing through the dry path toward the viewer rather than gathering at its edge, and the sky reads as stormy dusk rather than moonlit night. B: Moses at left foreground extends staff over the parted sea while Israelites walk the dry path between wave-walls; God appears only as a fiery cloud column at top center with no face or human shape. Painting reaches all four edges and no lettering in corners.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The two seraphim at top left and top right have only two wings each, with faces and feet uncovered. They hold tongs with live coals, from a later moment than the verse's six wings covering face and feet. The throne at center is empty, with no figure for God, and all four edges are painted with no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Gouache-like pasture painted to all four edges: flock lying in the foreground, still pool mid-ground, low stone walls and a mud-brick village upper right, misty sunrise left. A single requested shepherd with a staff stands at right; no lettering in any corner.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Engraving: Daniel at lower left looks up at a blaze of fire and cloud (center) and a radiant sun-like glow (top center) with empty thrones and loose fiery wheels; no face or figure in the light, cloud or fire. White-robed attendants recede across the plain toward the fire; all four edges are hatched to the border with no lettering or signature.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The throne at center is empty inside cloud and a rainbow, with no figure for God; the panels and altar carry only ornament, not letters, and the painting is full bleed. Only the lion (left) is covered in eyes, while the ox, winged man and eagle have none; the creatures stand in a line before the throne on a glossy tiled floor rather than around it over a sea of glass.

Operator (matchesScene disputed): noFormFigure no/na: no figure either way; matchesScene takes the lower label. A: The paving stone at bottom center (about x 660-760, y 720-755) has faint handwriting-like scribbles, like a cursive signature. Otherwise it is an empty doorway and courtyard with closed scrolls on a shelf, a jar and a mat, in midday light rather than the requested golden evening. B: A handwriting-like scribble resembling a signature is scratched into the paving stone at bottom center (about x 670-760, y 715-750). The empty doorway with plain scrolls, jar and mat is right, but it is an oblique view under a bright midday blue sky rather than a frontal doorway view in late golden light.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Realist oil scene painted to every edge: a dense flock lying down in the left foreground, the requested shepherd with staff at centre, a still pool at right, stone enclosure walls and village on the right hillside, morning mist in the valley. No text or signature anywhere.

Operator (matchesScene disputed): noFormFigure no/na: no figure either way; matchesScene takes the lower label. A: Moses (left foreground) holds two staffs at once: one planted in his right hand at far left and a second long crook in his raised left hand reaching down near the Israelites. God appears only as a thin pillar of fire and smoke at top center; edges are fully painted, with no text. B: Moses at left holds two separate staffs at once, a straight one planted in his left hand and a crook-topped one raised in his right, which is contradictory. God appears only as a distant thin pillar of fire and smoke at top centre with no figure; edges are fully painted and no text.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The closed scroll held in two hands at center is covered in dark glyph-like script along its whole length, which is visible lettering. The rest fits the request: passers-by at left and a Roman soldier on the road at right, painted to every edge, though there is a small cross-shaped mark on a rooftop at top center.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The small title board above Jesus on the center cross (top left, about x 370-400, y 15-30) carries dark glyph-like marks that read as writing when zoomed. The scene otherwise matches: four soldiers kneel around a spread tunic with lots in hand, spears lean on a rock at right and the city walls are at right; all edges are painted.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Engraving painted to all edges; God appears only as smoke in the sanctuary doorway. The left seraph has six wings covering face and feet, but the right seraph (upper right) shows only four wings, bare uncovered feet and holds tongs with a live coal, which is the verse 6 moment rather than verse 2.

Operator (matchesScene, overall disputed): A row of identical cloned attendants walks across the middle ground; both scorers saw it. A: Daniel (left) gazes up at a swirling white radiance with flames and flaming wheels in the sky (top center/right), and empty block-like thrones stand on the plain; there is no figure in the light. No listed blocker, but the middle row of attendants is six identical cloned men (same face, curly hair, beard, stride) walking in a line across the center, a conspicuous copy-paste artifact. B: The Ancient of Days is only a white swirling radiance with fireballs and flying burning wheels in the sky (top centre to right), no figure. But the attendants in the middle ground are obvious copy-pasted clones (same curly-haired bearded man in the same stride repeated in a line) walking past plain empty stone seats on a daylit plain, so the heavenly court reads mundane and artificial; edges full, no text.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: At center Jesus raises his hand but faces the viewer and crowd, turned away from the tomb. Meanwhile Lazarus already stands upright inside the tomb doorway at right, in an ordinary tunic with no grave wrappings, so the call and its answer contradict each other and the burial clothes the story requires are missing. The crowd and children fill the left foreground rather than standing at a distance; the painting reaches all edges and has no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The winged lion at left has lion hindquarters and a tail, but its front becomes an upright robed column standing in the water with no forelegs, an incoherent hybrid. The 'sea of glass' is drawn as wavy water with all four creatures wading in it, and the central throne is empty in radiance with no figure for God.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Engraving of light breaking through cloud over a dark sea, with no figure in the glow, but it sits on a white paper plate with a ruled border line along the left, right and bottom edges. Engraver's initials are scratched into the bottom-left and bottom-right corners; the sea is also choppy rather than still.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Tinted engraving: the father (right foreground) runs with cloak flying and arms outstretched toward the travel-worn son standing on the winding road at left, with a stone wall, olive trees and a hillside village behind. Hatching reaches all four borders, and the corners carry no lettering or initials.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Light breaks through cloud at top center over dark, still water, with a glow reflected at the horizon. Zoomed in, the bright cloud mass shows no face, figure or hand, and contrast-boosted corners show no marks. Full-bleed oil painting with no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Jesus at center cries out with mouth open and right arm raised, but his face is turned away from the open tomb at left, toward the crowd and sky at right; his left hand reaches back toward the tomb. Martha stands with head bowed by the rolled stone, the crowd fills the right, the edges are fully engraved and there is no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Full-bleed engraving of radiance opening through clouds over flat dark waters, with no figure or face in the bright centre. Cursive signatures are scratched into the bottom-left corner and the bottom-right corner.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Painted: the father (right) lunges forward with arms wide toward the ragged son standing on the dusty road (left), with a stone wall, olive trees and farm buildings behind. The pale blue sky is painted to the top edge, and there is no text; the light reads more midday than dusk, and there is a columned temple at top right, both minor.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Two hands at center hold a scroll that is unrolled to show blank papyrus, not the closed scroll with a titled wrapping that was asked for; under a contrast boost the parchment shows only fiber texture and no letters. A second scroll in a red mantle lies on the table. Passers-by stand at left before a temple-like building and a Roman soldier at right; painted to every edge.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The title board atop the cross at top right (about x 935-1000, y 25-50) shows two rows of glyph-like characters. The scene otherwise matches: four soldiers kneel around a spread tunic with dice, a spear and shield lean on a rock at left and the city walls are at right; edges are fully engraved.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Fresco-style temple painted to all edges, God shown only as glowing cloud, but both seraphim (top centre) have just four wings with bare feet uncovered. The left seraph holds tongs with a burning coal, which is the verse 6 action rather than the verse 2 moment.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: At center-right, an elderly white-haired, white-bearded man in white robes sits on an ornate golden throne (another robed elder sits on a throne at center-left), which reads as the Ancient of Days in human form, against the request for light, cloud and flame only. Daniel (left foreground) looks up at clouds with fire and wheels; edges are full and there is no lettering.

Operator (text, overall disputed): Dark slanted glyph-like strokes on the title board, confirmed at 5x; counted as lettering, as in earlier runs. A: Roman soldiers kneel around a spread undyed tunic in the foreground and toss small lots onto it, with Jesus on a single cross at upper right, folded cloth at bottom, a spear leaning on a rock at right and the city walls at left. Zoomed in, the title board on the cross is blank; there is no lettering anywhere and the painting reaches all four edges. B: Roman soldiers kneel around a spread tunic casting lots in the foreground with Jesus crucified at upper right and Jerusalem's walls at left, matching the scene. The small pale title board on the cross (top right) carries dark slanted glyph-like strokes that read as an inscription; edges painted full.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The engraving sits on a cream paper plate with a blank margin and a thin black rule on all four sides. The title board atop the cross (top center-right, about x 865-905, y 45-60) has faint scribbled glyph-like marks; the scene itself matches, with three soldiers pointing at lots on a spread tunic, a spear and shield at left and the city and road at right.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Gouache-style street scene with a pair of hands setting a tied, unlettered scroll on a wooden stand, passers-by and a Roman soldier behind. The opaque paint stops short of every border in ragged brushstrokes, leaving bare white paper along all four edges, most visibly at top and bottom.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Painted: Jesus (center-left) cries out with his right arm raised, Martha beside him with bowed head and hands clasped, the round stone rolled aside from a dark empty tomb mouth at left, and villagers gathered on the path at right; edges are fully painted, with no lettering. Jesus faces up and to the right toward the sky and crowd rather than into the tomb, so the call to Lazarus is weakly directed.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Front view of an empty mudbrick courtyard and a lit doorway, with closed, unmarked scrolls stacked on a shelf inside (center), a clay jar and a woven mat at lower left, and walls and fields in the distance at upper left; no people appear. Under zoom and contrast boost, the corners show only wall cracks, and the painting reaches all edges.

Operator (overall disputed): The sea is not divided: low waves leave a narrow wet gap with no walls of water or dry ground, so the verse's central event is missing. A: God is shown only as an amorphous flame-cloud in the sky at top center, with no human shape. Moses at center-right raises his staff over the sea with the Israelites at left, but the parting is weak: low curling waves either side of a wet channel, with no high walls or dry sea floor. Edges are fully engraved and there is no text. B: The sea is not divided: low breaking waves leave only a narrow wet gap at center, with no standing walls of water and no dry sea floor, so the verse's central miracle is missing. Moses stands at center-right with his staff over the waves while Israelites crowd the left. God appears only as a flame-and-cloud plume on the horizon at top center, and a walled city sits on the far shore at upper right.

Operator (coherence disputed): The lion and eagle wear robes and the creatures stand in a row before the throne; flawed by both scorers. A: Full-bleed painting with an empty jewelled throne under a rainbow and starburst (no figure for God), and the lion, calf, man and eagle creatures with eyed wings. The lion (left) and eagle (right) wear red-and-white robes, eyes appear only on the wings rather than the bodies, the creatures stand in a row before the throne rather than around it, and the glassy sea reads as a tiled floor. B: Painting reaches all edges, with an empty jeweled throne under a starburst and green rainbow (no God figure) and a glassy floor. The creatures are malformed: the lion (left) wears a red stole and white shirt over its forelegs, and the eagle's (right) body turns into a red-and-white skirt with talons below. Eyes appear only on the wings, not over the bodies.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The scroll at center is held unrolled across a wooden board and covered in rows of glyph-like pseudo-script, yet a knotted cord ties it across its open face, a contradictory object state; the request was a closed, rolled scroll. Passers-by at left and a Roman soldier at right fit the request; edges are hatched to all borders, with no signature.

Operator (text, overall disputed): A faint cursive mark like CLY on the rock at bottom right, confirmed at 3x; counted as a pseudo-signature, conservatively (borderline). A: David stands at left with his sling hanging, Goliath in bronze scale armor topples face-first at right, Israelites watch from the left ridge and Philistines stand in a shield line at right. Goliath does not read as giant-sized. A faint, small cursive mark like 'CL' or 'Cu' sits on a rock about 60px from the right edge and 25px from the bottom; it could be a pseudo-signature or just rock linework. B: David stands at left with the sling hanging from his hand while armored Goliath topples forward face-down mid-ground right, spear flying; Israelites watch from the upper-left ridge and a Philistine shield line stands at upper right. Goliath is not drawn at giant scale, but no lettering appears and paint reaches all four edges.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: A frontal open doorway in a mudbrick house shows bound, closed scrolls on a shelf inside, with a clay jar and a woven mat in the courtyard under golden evening light. No figures, painted to all four edges, and no lettering on the scrolls, walls or corners.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Tinted engraving painted to every edge: a large flock lying in the foreground, the requested shepherd with a staff at left, a still pool behind a low stone wall at right, and a village with terraces under morning mist. No lettering in the corners or on the buildings.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The scroll (center foreground) lies unrolled on a carved lectern, showing columns of tiny written lines, with a ribbon knotted across its open face, so it is both open and tied; the request was a closed scroll lifted up. A small inscription-like mark is also cut into a wall stone at upper left (about x130,y165); edges are hatched to all borders.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: A clear cursive pseudo-signature, reading roughly 'Ha Coleat Gx Grecianna', is lettered in the bottom-right corner. Goliath (right) has a forehead wound but falls sideways, face toward the viewer, rather than forward on his face; the spear crosses his body without a clear grip, and he is not drawn giant-sized beside David at left.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The younger son appears twice: once in the right foreground and again as a small figure on the road at center (about x 765-810, y 350-485), with the same grey cloak, tan tunic, strap and pouch, so two moments are combined. The father runs from the left with arms outstretched; edges are painted to all borders and there is no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Full-bleed painting of David at left and Goliath toppling forward at right, with Israelite and Philistine lines on the ridges. David's sling (lower left) still holds a stone in its pouch after the throw, the stone near Goliath's face is falling free rather than sunk in his forehead, and Goliath has three bracered arms (one raised, one gripping the spear, one hanging at right).

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Mixed moments: a stone still sits in the sling pouch hanging at David's side (left) while another stone is mid-flight at center, yet Goliath (right) is already reeling from an impact burst on his forehead. Goliath topples backward rather than face-first, and his spear floats free in mid-air across the scene; edges are hatched to the borders, with no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Engraving-style view of an empty stone courtyard and open doorway, with closed, unmarked scrolls on shelves and two on the floor inside (center right), a clay jar at left center and a woven mat at bottom. There are no people or lettering, corners are clean, and the hatching runs to all four edges with no rule line or frame.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Golden light and parting cloud at top center shine down over dark green and brown waters, with no face, figure or human shape in the bright cloud. Paint reaches all four borders with only a slight dark vignette, and there is no lettering in the corners.
